# Pull Request

## Summary
- Brief summary of the change.

## Changes
- What was added/changed/removed (high-level bullets).

## Motivation & Context
- Why is this change needed? Link product/tech context.

## Screenshots / Video (UI)
- Before/After as applicable.

## How to Test
- Steps to verify locally (routes, roles, feature flags, data).

## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added/updated where sensible
- [ ] Error handling follows `{ error: { code, message } }`
- [ ] RBAC/permissions enforced (authz helpers used)
- [ ] No secrets/PII in code or logs
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior/API changed

## Linked Issues
- Closes #<id>

## Breaking Changes
- Describe any breaking API/DB/behavior changes

## Deployment Notes
- Env var changes:
- Cron/webhooks/3P configs:
